bugs.what: Game cut off at turn 80 before I could complete the ending. I had collected all three verses (stone, wind, water) and knew I needed to return to the barrow throne with the king's crown (locked in elder's coffer) to speak the verses and let the king rest.

confusions: The turn limit (80) may be artificial and stopping me from reaching a real ending
Elder's coffer lock mechanic required 'better words' but wasn't clear what dialog would work
suggestions: Increase turn limit beyond 80 or track progress toward ending more clearly
Make it clearer when player is on final steps toward an ending
Consider optional faster-travel between distant locations in a large map
